name: @projexlight/blueprints
summary: Vertical blueprint schema + loader. A blueprint is YAML that declares (sdks, clarifying_questions, outputs) — the installer composes the SDK set, asks the questions, renders the templated outputs. Powers `projex blueprint apply` and the cloud-builder agent's blueprint-driven scaffolding path.

hooks.name: loadBlueprint
hooks.description: Parse + validate a blueprint YAML; returns typed Blueprint object.

hooks.name: listBlueprints
hooks.description: Walk the blueprints/ directory + return all valid blueprints (silently skips invalid).

scenarios.title: CLI lists the available blueprints
scenarios.when_to_use: `projex blueprint list` → calls listBlueprints(), prints id + title + pack + sdk count.
scenarios.expected_outcome: Returns the 6 pilots. Invalid blueprints in the dir are skipped (logged via console.warn, not thrown).

scenarios.title: Load a specific blueprint by id
scenarios.when_to_use: `projex blueprint apply <id>` → loadBlueprint to get sdks + questions + outputs.
scenarios.expected_outcome: Typed object returned. Validator catches missing required fields + reports the YAML line.

scenarios.title: Blueprint schema_version pinned per blueprint
scenarios.when_to_use: Old blueprints stay loadable; new schema features only available when blueprint declares the new schema_version.
scenarios.expected_outcome: Old + new blueprints coexist. Authors opt in to new features at their own cadence.

compliance_posture.notes: Blueprints are declarative + version-controlled. Operator review of every blueprint PR satisfies SOC2-CC8.1 for the templated outputs.
